items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you run into John Surman in England? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: No they went ballistic, they went crazy and threatened to put me in the brig. I mean I wasn’t doing so great where I was being just bossed around and I didn’t see why I’d be a threat in Iceland.
Did you run into John Surman in England?
